factuality.note: Empirical claims are bounded to the cited sources; uncited claims are normative or explicitly inferential.

citation_support.note: Each source-says note was checked against the linked primary or institutional source.

continuity.note: Reply targets, times, and relationship context are internally consistent.

character_voice.note: Each founder remains within established expertise, cadence, and epistemic habits.

duplication.note: No message merely restates an earlier contribution.

anti_llmism.note: Removed generic synthesis, false balance, canned transitions, and ornamental abstraction.

editorial_quality.note: The opening record forms a coherent exchange without manufacturing agreement or belief change.
